title: When Plans Change, Remember: Replanning-Guided Visual Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22556v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon, multi-stage Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often require visual information that is no longer present in the current observation. Retaining the complete observation history is computationally expensive and highly redundant, motivating selective visual memory. We introduce RePlanMem-VLA (Replanning-Guided Keyframe Memory for VLA), which turns a policy's own plan revisions into an online memory-write signal. Under receding-horizon execution, consecutive action chunks predict some of the same future actions. RePlanMem-VLA treats unusually large disagreement between these temporally aligned predictions as evidence of a task-relevant event. We first compare 35 disagreement measures across single-task autoregressive decoder-only and Flow-Matching Transformers trained from scratch, then validate the selected signals on pretrained OpenVLA-OFT and $\pi_{0.5}$ policies over MIKASA-Robo-VLA tasks. translated_title: 当计划改变时，请记住：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的基于重规划引导的视觉记忆
translated_abstract: 长时程、多阶段的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略常常需要当前观测中已不存在的视觉信息。保留完整的观测历史在计算上代价高昂且高度冗余，因此需要选择性的视觉记忆。我们提出了 RePlanMem-VLA（面向 VLA 的重规划引导关键帧记忆），它将策略自身的计划修订转化为在线记忆写入信号。在滚动时域执行下，连续的动作块会预测部分相同的未来动作，RePlanMem-VLA 将这些时间对齐的预测之间异常巨大的分歧视为发生任务相关事件的证据。我们首先在从头训练的单任务自回归仅解码器模型和流匹配Transformer上比较了 35 种分歧度量方法，随后在 MIKASA-Robo-VLA 任务上使用预训练的 OpenVLA-OFT 和 π0.5 策略对所选信号进行了验证。所得的检测器实现了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出RePlanMem-VLA，将VLA策略自身的重规划行为（即连续动作块预测之间出现的异常巨大分歧）作为在线写入视觉记忆的信号，以选择性保存关键帧，解决长时程任务中关键视觉信息已不在当前观测中的问题。
en_tdlr: RePlanMem-VLA converts a policy's own plan revisions—detected as unusually large disagreement between temporally aligned predictions of consecutive action chunks—into an online memory-write signal for selective keyframe visual memory, enabling long-horizon VLA tasks to access task-relevant visual information no longer present in current observations.
